title: mobsfriendly
description: this is a mod that makes hostile mobs neutral to special players
body:
You can add mobs and tags in the config files as examples. Once configured, the corresponding mobs will remain "neutral" towards players who possess this tag. This means they will not attack you unless you attack them first

ATTENTION

This mod does NOT include any mechanics to apply "tags" to players. So you'll have to apply "tags" to players through other means, like KubeJS or any ways you like
